services.name: Winter Fishing
services.desc: The often calm, protected waters throughout Clayoquot Sound provide a fantastic setting for a wonderful day on the water. Salmon, halibut, lingcod and rockfish will chase abundant schools of baitfish throughout the inlets and your guide knows the spots they like to frequent. Crab and Prawn traps are set throughout the sound where eagles, seals and sea otters are often spotted along the way to and from the fishing

blurb: Guests fish for salmon, halibut, lingcod, prawns, and crabs in the calm, protected waters of Clayoquot Sound and the west coast of Vancouver Island. The business offers private whale watching, bear watching, photography tours, sunset harbor cruises, and remote surf trips. Trips are family friendly and can be combined with wildlife viewing and visits to natural hot springs.
